review_method: Viewed every generated asset and the six final contact sheets on alternating dark and light backgrounds.
checked: Recognizable source palette, costume, headgear, unit type and equipment
Mounted heroes remain mounted; foot soldiers and machines retain their respective unit types
Complete primary silhouette and readable face, equipment and pose
Consistent polished chibi rendering and square framing
Transparent-background appearance on light and dark review backgrounds

refinements.change: Recomposed the sword and cape to remove the detached white patch beside the blade; selected the rebuilt version.
Refined the spearhead to a darker steel surface with clearer edges; selected the rebuilt version.

raw_border_reviews.finding: Raw silhouette approaches the right edge; the visible timber, wheels and ram remain complete. Final normalized asset has transparent safety margins.
